title: Sleeping Newborn Baby Wrapped in Blanket, 1960 B&W Vintage Snapshot Photo
description: A tender black-and-white square snapshot photo capturing a serene newborn baby sleeping soundly, wrapped in a patterned blanket. The photo print features a developer date stamp along the top margin reading OCT 60, placing it in October 1960 during the post-WWII American baby boom era. The intimate close-up framing highlights the peaceful expression and tiny features of the newborn.
